subject: Polity
q: Which Article of the Constitution of India safeguards one's right to marry the person of one's choice?
exp: In the Hadiya case (2018), the Supreme Court held that the right to marry a person of one's choice is an integral part of Article 21.

subject: Polity
q: A Money Bill passed by the Lok Sabha can be delayed by the Rajya Sabha for a maximum period of:
exp: Under Article 109, the Rajya Sabha must return a Money Bill within 14 days, failing which it is deemed passed by both Houses.

subject: Economy
q: If the RBI decides to adopt an expansionist monetary policy, which of the following would it NOT do?
options: Cut and optimize the Statutory Liquidity Ratio
Increase the Marginal Standing Facility Rate
Cut the Bank Rate and Repo Rate
Buy government securities in Open Market Operations
exp: Increasing the MSF rate makes borrowing costlier and reduces liquidity (contractionary), whereas expansionist policy increases money supply.

subject: Economy
q: Which of the following is included in the Capital Budget of the Government of India?
options: Expenditure on acquisition of assets like roads and buildings
Loans and advances granted to the States
exp: Capital Budget includes both Capital Receipts (foreign loans, disinvestment) and Capital Expenditure (asset creation, loans to states).

subject: Geography
q: Which of the following rivers does NOT originate in India?
exp: The Sutlej originates near Lake Rakshastal in Tibet (China) and enters India through the Shipki La pass.

subject: Geography
q: Siachen Glacier is situated to the:
exp: Siachen Glacier lies in the eastern Karakoram range, immediately north of the Nubra Valley.

subject: Modern History
q: In the context of Colonial India, Shah Nawaz Khan, Prem Kumar Sehgal and Gurbaksh Singh Dhillon are remembered as:
options: Members of the Interim Government in 1946
Officers of the Indian National Army
exp: They were the three INA officers famously tried together in the Red Fort Trials (1945–46).

subject: Modern History
q: Who among the following was associated as Secretary with Hindu Female School which later came to be known as Bethune Female School?
exp: Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar served as the Secretary of the Bethune School, established in 1849 in Calcutta.

subject: Ancient & Culture
q: With reference to the history of ancient India, Bhavabhuti, Hastimalla and Kshemeshvara were famous:
exp: Bhavabhuti, Hastimalla, and Kshemeshvara were renowned Sanskrit/Prakrit playwrights.

subject: Ancient & Culture
q: Which of the following Harappan sites is famous for its dockyard?
exp: Lothal in Gujarat was a major port town of the Indus Valley Civilization known for its brick-built tidal dockyard.

subject: Environment
q: Which of the following Protected Areas are located in Cauvery basin?
exp: Nagarhole, Sathyamangalam, and Wayanad lie in the Cauvery basin, whereas Papikonda lies in the Godavari basin.

subject: Environment
q: Under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, which Schedule provides the highest degree of protection to endangered species?
exp: Schedule I grants absolute protection; offences under this schedule attract the highest penalties.

subject: Science & Tech
q: With reference to communication technologies, what is the difference between LTE and VoLTE?
options: LTE is commonly marketed as 3G and VoLTE as 4G
LTE is data-only technology and VoLTE is voice-only technology
exp: LTE is 4G broadband (data + packet-switched), while VoLTE allows voice calls over the 4G LTE network alongside data.

subject: Science & Tech
q: Which of the following is used as a moderator in nuclear reactors?
exp: Heavy water (D2O) and graphite are used as moderators to slow down fast neutrons; Cadmium/Boron are used as control rods.
